The ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is PD-4821. I replied to Hollis in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The number comes from Hollis's own post in #central-team on Jun 9, and he's a member of that channel. In that post he noted the import file labels the doors E1/E2 while Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02, and I included that in the reply.
